## Part A - Arithmetic Operations
```{r}
a <- 17
b <- 5

a + b
a - b
a * b
a / b

a %% b
a %/% b

2^10
```
## Part B - Basic Data types
```{r}
x <- 42
y <- 42L
z <- "42"
w <- TRUE
v <- 3+2i

typeof(x)
typeof(y)
typeof(z)
typeof(w)
typeof(v)

class(x)
class(y)
class(z)
class(w)
class(v)

mode(x)
mode(y)
mode(z)
mode(w)
mode(v)

```
